name: filesystem-ultra
description: Safe local filesystem for AI agents. MCP 2025-11-25, stdio, Windows binary.
long_description: Backups with step-through undo, optimistic concurrency, and a fail-closed allowlist. This bundle is Windows-only. It does not implement MCP 2026-07-28 (Tasks, stateless Streamable HTTP). The canonical name is filesystem-ultra (github.com/scopweb/mcp-filesystem-go-ultra), not mcp-filesystem-server-ultra.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed directories
allowed_directories.description: Directories this server may read and write. At least one is required. Pick the project folder, not the whole disk.
